description:
`work_item.assigned@1`: who is going to work on an item, or its place
in their queue, changed (`oxplow.work_item.assign`, `.reorder`; a
closed item or a closed thread's releases it). Core's record, for every
provider; the `work_items.project` consumer keeps `v_work_item.assignee`
and `rank` from it.

after.description: Placed just after this item of `to`'s queue (neither: at its end).

before.description: Placed just before this item of `to`'s queue.

from.description: Who it was assigned to: a thread's URI, the person's; absent, nobody.

to.description: Who it's assigned to now; absent, nobody.

title: WorkItemAssignedV1
